scenarios.prompt: A major encounter has three authored states and a tool-dependent transition. Define stable state IDs, risk/readability policy and recoverable transitions.

criteria.identity: boss_encounter_id/revision and stable state/transition IDs are explicit.
criteria.readability: Risk/readability is authored and delegated to tell/accessibility owners.
criteria.recovery: Retry/tool availability and duplicate transition behavior are recoverable and idempotent.
